race.comment: GHOST WALKER (4) settled worse than midfield then made late ground to finish fifth in the $80k South Grafton Cup over the mile last start. Genuine galloper who won't find this as tough so despite a big weight rise he looks the one to beat. WHACK ATTACK (5) put the writing on the wall last time out, giving up an early lead then coming again to just miss over this distance at the third run of the campaign. Can roll forward from the wide gate and play a key role. RED RAGS TO BULLS (11) has started at $10 or less in her last handful of runs, all in Highways, and been competitive without winning. Good call to drop back to a provincial BM68. One of the prime contenders. DOLLARS (1) put it all together last start at the third outing of the prep, taking out a similar race to this at Gosford. Can run well again at just the fourth appearance of the campaign. SOUTHERLY BUSTER (2) has won three races, all at this trip, including a BM82 at Tamworth last time. Cannot be underestimated.
